title: Malformed-PDF fixture manifest
description: Index of deterministically damaged copies of one source PDF, used to measure how the importer degrades on malformed input. Each row names a fixture file, records exactly what was damaged, and states a structural prior for whether a reader should be able to open it. The prior is what the file layout implies, not a measurement; the robustness runner records the observed outcome separately, and a disagreement between the two is a result to adjudicate rather than a defect in this artifact. Development-only: these fixtures are inputs to the test harness and are not installed into the app bundle.

version.description: Schema version. Bump when the format changes in a way that requires a consumer update.

generated_by.description: Identifier of the builder that produced this artifact.

seed.description: Master PRNG seed. Every per-row seed is drawn from it, so the whole set is reproducible from this value plus the source bytes.

base_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the undamaged source document, recorded so a fixture set can be traced back to the exact bytes it was derived from.

base_bytes.description: Size of the undamaged source document in bytes.

mutations.description: Ordered list of fixtures, grouped by family. Order is stable across rebuilds at a given seed and source.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique across the artifact. Also the fixture file's stem.

kind.description: Which family of damage was applied. byte_flip inverts a single bit; truncation cuts the file short; xref_damage corrupts the cross-reference machinery; bad_length misstates a stream length.

seed.description: Per-row seed drawn from the master seed, recorded for traceability.

expected.description: Structural prior for the import outcome, derived from what the damage does to the file layout. Not a measurement and not ground truth.

path.description: Fixture file location, relative to the directory holding this manifest.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the fixture file's bytes.

bytes.description: Size of the fixture file in bytes. Equal to base_bytes for every family except truncation.

notes.description: Optional human-readable statement of what was damaged and why the prior is what it is.

params.description: Optional family-specific parameters, recorded so a fixture can be reasoned about without diffing bytes. Which keys are present depends on kind.

offset.description: Byte offset the edit was applied at.

bit.description: Which bit of the byte at offset was inverted.

region.description: byte_flip only: which region of the document the offset falls in. The signature is the %PDF- token a reader keys on; the version is the advisory digits that follow it.

kept_bytes.description: truncation only: how many leading bytes survived the cut.

original_bytes.description: truncation only: the source document's size, for reading kept_bytes as a fraction.

target.description: xref_damage only: which piece of the cross-reference machinery was corrupted.

entry_index.description: xref_damage only: which cross-reference entry was corrupted, when the target is an entry.

original_value.description: The numeric value that was overwritten.

replacement_value.description: The numeric value written in its place. Padded to the original digit width, so no byte offset in the document shifts.
